active_loop.feedback: After each batch the protected evaluator reveals only that batch selected-label vector to the arm process, which refits from scratch on all screened rows.
active_loop.initialization: Within each class and review, choose the row minimizing SHA-256(review UTF-8, NUL, canonical record identity); positive first then negative. Exactly one seed per class. No cold-start claim.
active_loop.same_information_rule: All four cells receive identical per-review population, two seed identities, batch schedule and revealed label history conditional on their selected queries.
active_loop.termination: Order every canonical row; do not stop at a favorable threshold.
active_loop.ties: Stable descending score, then canonical ascending record identity.

arms.R0_L1: candidate representation plus V4-selected u4 learner/balancer
arms.R1_L1: complete active u4 comparator; unchanged from V5

custody_contract.pre_execution: Each role signs exact source SHA-256, population SHA-256, protocol SHA-256, runner SHA-256, dependency lock and container/platform identity before opening expert_inclusion row values.
custody_contract.separation: No role may be performed by this V6 design session or the V3-V5 execution session if a confirmatory claim is intended.
custody_contract.write_surfaces: Candidate and comparator write only arm-specific rankings/state; protected evaluator alone reads hidden source label column and writes metrics/terminal; append-only negative ledger cannot be overwritten.

decision_rule.cannot_check: If B1, B2 or B3 fails, or a selected label cannot be semantically mapped, emit the CANNOT_CHECK terminal without comparative performance claims.
decision_rule.negative: If B1-B3 pass but any C1-C6 or G3-G6 gate fails, preserve all effects and emit the adverse terminal. No review deletion, retuning or endpoint substitution.
decision_rule.positive: Only the conjunction B1-B3, C1-C6 and G3-G6 permits the narrow family-specific positive terminal. It still does not establish domain-general, source-general, workflow-general or population-wide superiority.

estimands.full_candidate_minus_u4: Per review m(R0,L0)-m(R1,L1), with unweighted mean.
estimands.learner_balancer_main_effect: Per review and metric m, Delta_L,r(m)=0.5*[(m(R0,L1)-m(R0,L0))+(m(R1,L1)-m(R1,L0))]. Aggregate by unweighted mean over all fourteen reviews.
estimands.multiplicity: Noncompensatory conjunction: both coprimary endpoints and every safety/work-saving gate must pass. No endpoint can compensate another.

forbidden_claims: independent custody before a signed external receipt
causal mechanism identification beyond the fixed 2x2 contrast
positive result before every noncompensatory gate passes
globally unstudied, historically outcome-sealed or public-artifact-free source family

gates.B1_BINDING: Every exact source, rights, revision, population, protocol, implementation, environment and custody hash passes.
gates.B2_POPULATION: Exactly 14 reviews and 4,934 canonical rows; zero final SWIFT/V5 content or PMID overlap; zero pairwise KIFMS overlap; both selected-label classes in every review.
gates.B3_INDEPENDENT_CUSTODY: Protected executor is organizationally/session-disjoint from the design and V3-V5 execution contexts, signs pre-outcome source/protocol/implementation manifests, and keeps hidden labels/outcomes inaccessible until the terminal receipt is sealed.
gates.C2_CRE20_SIGN: Learner/balancer Delta_L(CRE20) is strictly positive in at least 12 of 14 reviews.
gates.C3_R10_MAGNITUDE: Unweighted mean learner/balancer Delta_L(R@10) >= 0.010858985820770889; this V5 threshold is unchanged.
gates.C4_R10_SIGN: Learner/balancer Delta_L(R@10) is strictly positive in at least 12 of 14 reviews; 80% preserves the V5 four-of-five rule.
gates.G6_ABSOLUTE_WORK_SAVING: R0_L0 WSS95 > 0 in every review; unchanged.

L1_u4.balancer: positive weight 1; negative weight positives/(9.8*negatives); normalize mean one

metrics.cre20: CRE20_r=(1/(0.20*P_r))*sum_{i=1}^{N_r} y_i*max(0.20-i/N_r,0). This is the exact normalized integral of the right-continuous full-ranking recall-effort step function over effort [0,0.20].
metrics.effort95: E95_r=min{k/N_r: cumulative relevant through rank k >= ceil(0.95*P_r)}.
metrics.rank_coordinate: For a complete order i=1..N_r with binary y_i and P_r=sum_i y_i, screening event i occurs at effort i/N_r.
metrics.recall_at_q: R_r(q)=sum_{i=1}^{ceil(q*N_r)} y_i / P_r for q in {0.05,0.10,0.20}; ceil and minimum one exactly preserve prior P2 metric mechanics.
metrics.requirement: P_r must be positive and less than N_r for every review; otherwise the entire V6 identity is CANNOT_CHECK before any arm is promoted.

motivation.rationale_for_continuous_endpoint: V5 exhibited nonuniform R@5/R@10/R@20 behavior. V6 therefore replaces tail interpretation by a prospectively fixed normalized area under the complete recall-effort step function over the first 20% effort, while retaining adverse R@10 unchanged as a coprimary endpoint.
motivation.v5_adverse_result: Learner/balancer mean R@10 effect +0.008834277869043594, positive 3/5 and zero 2/5; candidate-minus-u4 R@10 and WSS@95 negative.

outcome_access_status: NO KIFMS LABEL VALUES, CLASS COUNTS, SEEDS, ACTIVE ORDERS, OR CANDIDATE/COMPARATOR OUTCOMES ACCESSED

population.disjointness_evidence: Content identity is operative. KIFMS pubmed_id is present as a header but empty in every row, so PMID-overlap zeros are reported as vacuous, not corroborative.
population.label: expert_inclusion only, protected until execution

prior_public_artifact_boundary: Public historical ASReview simulation artifact paths exist for these datasets. Their metric contents were not opened in V6; this fact must be disclosed in any execution report.
secondary_reporting: Every metric for every arm and review, plus all factorial effects and unweighted means.
Exact count of strictly positive review effects and the two-sided exact binomial sign-test value, descriptive only because this finite family is not a random sample.
R@5 and R@20 retained only as secondary diagnostics; neither can rescue a failed coprimary endpoint.
Complete ranking hashes, batch/query trajectory hashes, fit counts and software/environment identities.
